summary: Implementation plan for transforming the Movies & Series window into a full Liquid Glass interface: fixing the Sound/Back button overlap, fixing the poster hover zoom so artwork is always visible, upgrading the Movie/Series details modal and practical trailer viewer, and replacing the Watch Now modal with an in-app 16:9 Liquid Glass iframe player that automatically tests the 3 streaming sources with top server-switching controls and automatic fallback to the external source selector.
